ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( ISPICKVAL(ApprovalStatus__c, "Pending") || ISPICKVAL(ApprovalStatus__c, "Approved") ) && ( ISCHANGED(SBQQ__PricebookId__c) || ISCHANGED(SBQQ__PaymentTerms__c) || ISCHANGED(Region__c) || ISCHANGED(Product_Price_Type__c) /* ISCHANGED(SBQQ__CustomerDiscount__c) || */ /* ISCHANGED(SBQQ__PartnerDiscount__c) || */ /*|| ISCHANGED(SBQQ__ExpirationDate__c)*/ ) && NOT($User.Locked_Quotes_Editor__c) && ( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" || $Profile.Name <> "API/ADMIN/NON MFA" ) && NOT(Has_Bypass_Site__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Quotes that are approved or pending approval cannot be edited unless the approval request is recalled.
